Bread Science: Sourdough Starter
description: Cooking Class Description: There's real science behind a thriving sourdough starter — and in this intimate four-person workshop; you'll learn exactly how it works. name: Cooking with Staub: French Classics
description: Cooking Class Description: Discover the craft behind Staub's legendary enamel-coated cast iron in this exclusive sponsored class. Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

You and your partner will transform pork chops into crisp golden Schnitzel and dress up pillowy homemade Spaetzle with brown butter and fresh herbs. A crisp Bitter Greens Salad with Whole Grain Mustard Vinaigrette keeps things bright and balanced; and you'll finish with a silky Bavarian Cream topped with a vibrant Raspberry Compote.What To Expect: In our classes you'll work together with other students (in groups of 4); sharing workstations and equipment in a fun; hands-on environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 2 hours; unless otherwise noted above.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-20 students; depending on location.You will be standing; cooking; and working for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back.Students receive a coupon for 10% off in-store purchases the day of class.Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class.Prices vary by location.Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

description: Cooking Class Description: Learn all about the flaky and buttery goodness that goes into making the perfect French croissant in this hands-on 3-hour class. Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Your chef instructor will guide you through the fermentation process from the ground up; covering flour types; water quality; hydration ratios; and the role wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria play in building flavor. You'll mix and seal your own day-one starter; then observe a hands-on demo of discarding and feeding a mature culture. Troubleshooting; maintenance methods; and discard uses round out the hour. Leave with your starter; rye flour; and a complete recipe packet to carry the process home.What To Expect: In our classes you'll work together with other students (in groups of 4); sharing workstations and equipment in a fun; hands-on environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 2 hours; unless otherwise noted above.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-20 students; depending on location.You will be standing; cooking; and working for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back.Students receive a coupon for 10% off in-store purchases the day of class.Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class.Prices vary by location.Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.
